name: Bu/cunzai de Zhumengzhe: Yin Cong zhi Sen
original_name: 不/存在的逐梦者：银葱之森
source:
This is the unfinished story between you and her—this is the journey that belongs to YOU…
Awakening within the Forest of Silver Shallots, you set forth on a path to uncover the secrets of the “Morphean Paradox.”

Across the land, the schemes of great factions ripple across the surface, while beneath, dark mist stirs in hidden currents.

Forge bonds or sow hatred, and bear witness to the fate of you, your companions, and the Silver Shallot Forest itself.

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942480/]Steam[/url]]
